$comment: Named brief sets for dialed_moods_gen.mjs. A brief is: name, product (an id from catalog.json compounds), eyebrow, headline (the white part), gold (the closing phrase set in brushed-metal gold), support (one or more short lines), and optional `extra` for anything structural the layout needs. Every string is reproduced verbatim by the model. Copy a block, change the words, run it — no code editing.

socialElixirLaunch.name: 1_announce
socialElixirLaunch.headline: Unwind without
support: A non-alcoholic kava seltzer with a calm you can actually feel.
socialElixirLaunch.extra: · a gold pill-shaped button reading exactly "Shop Social Elixir"

socialElixirLaunch.name: 2_whats_in_it
socialElixirLaunch.headline: Every can,
socialElixirLaunch.extra:
· beneath the headline a clean vertical spec list, each row a large gold number then a white word, separated by thin hairline rules, reading exactly:
  "180mg kavalactones", "200mg potassium", "50mg magnesium", "20mg sodium"
· a single row of small outlined pill badges reading exactly "10 CAL", "ZERO SUGAR", "GLUTEN-FREE", "VEGAN"

socialElixirLaunch.name: 3_how_to_use
socialElixirLaunch.headline: Made for
socialElixirLaunch.extra:
· three numbered steps, each a small gold numeral then a bold white line, reading exactly:
  "01 Chill it hard.", "02 Crack one as the night starts.", "03 One can, one occasion."
· frosty cold condensation beads on the can's metal

socialElixirLaunch.name: 4_why_different
socialElixirLaunch.headline: Most zero-proof drinks taste like
socialElixirLaunch.extra: · two short stacked lines each behind a thin gold vertical rule, reading exactly "Felt, not implied." and "Drinks clean."

socialElixirLaunch.name: 5_tomorrow_proof
socialElixirLaunch.headline: Fun tonight.
socialElixirLaunch.extra: · at the bottom, two short columns divided by a thin gold vertical rule, reading exactly "TONIGHT — You're in it." and "7:00 AM — You're fine."
